whenToUse: Events tied to dates, such as team schedules, classes, or bookings.
People need to see at a glance which days of the month are busy.
People press a date to check its events.
whenNotToUse: You only take a single date (use a date picker).
Days are packed and times matter (use a week or day view).
Events are sparse (a list is easier to read).
accessibility: Put the count in date button names, such as "2 events", instead of relying on dots.
Today is aria-current="date" and the chosen day aria-pressed.
The month name and the event list below announce changes with aria-live.
Previous and next month buttons have names.
